buffer_format.buffer_ms: S*1000+900 for crops; len/16+900 for full clip

description: SD3 capture-shaped speaker evaluation: buffers = noise450ms + clip crop + noise450ms; wespeaker_ref CMN fbank -> ResNet34; enrollment = l2n(mean(l2n(e_a,e_b,e_c))) of full-clip buffers

min_verify_derivation.rule: smallest candidate in {1500,2000,2500,3000} such that every buffer_ms >= candidate has min owner cos - max impostor cos >= 0.05

raw_matrix_accept.cross_check: recomputed owner accept / impostor FA equal speaker_matrix.json stored values (asserted < 1e-9)
raw_matrix_accept.scope: raw clips, duration>=1.5 s or full (speaker_matrix.json convention)

seed_formula: seed = 10000*spk_idx + 100*letter_idx + crop_idx; spk_idx=N(sN), letter_idx=a..e->0..4, crop_idx=0..6 for S in [0.4,0.6,0.8,1.0,1.5,2.0,3.0], 7=full; rng=default_rng(seed); pre=standard_normal(7200)*1e-4, post=next standard_normal(7200)*1e-4, cast float32
